readAloud.piperVietnameseOnly: This voice can only read Vietnamese.
readAloud.piperUnsupported: This browser can't run the Chuyen Nho voice. Use the device voice instead.
readAloud.piperModelFailed: Couldn't download the voice. Check your connection and try again.
readAloud.piperFailed: Couldn't create audio for this text.
readAloud.piperTimeout: Creating audio took too long and was stopped. Try a shorter text.
readAloud.deviceFailed: The browser stopped reading part-way. Press "Read text aloud" to start again.

readAloud.fileHint: PDF up to {{pdfSize}}, DOCX/TXT up to {{textSize}}. The file is read on your device and never uploaded.
readAloud.ocrIntro: {{pages}} page(s) are scanned images; the text was recognised automatically and may be wrong. Check the highlighted words, then press the button at the end of the review to listen.
readAloud.ocrSkipped: Only the first {{max}} scanned pages are recognised; the other {{skipped}} scanned pages are not read.
readAloud.ocrReviewed: You have checked the text recognised from scanned pages.
readAloud.partsNote: Long text is split into {{total}} parts of up to {{max}} characters each.

readAloud.rememberHint: Only the reading position is saved in this browser, never the text. Turning it off deletes saved positions.

readAloud.linkSoon: Reading from a link is not available yet. Copy the article text and paste it in the Paste text tab.

errors.PAYWALL: This article needs a login or payment, so Chuyen Nho does not fetch it.
errors.ROBOTS_DENIED: This website does not allow automated tools to read its content.
errors.UNSUPPORTED: This file or content cannot be read. Supported: PDF, Word (DOCX) and TXT.
errors.TTS_UNAVAILABLE: This device has no voice for {{language}}. You can still read the text; to listen, install a voice in your device's text-to-speech settings, or use the Chuyen Nho voice for Vietnamese.
errors.OCR_UNCERTAIN: Text recognised from scanned pages may be wrong. You can listen only after checking it.
errors.OFFLINE: You are offline. Online voices and the first download of the Chuyen Nho voice need a connection; you can still read the text.
errors.TOO_LARGE: This content is too large to process on this device. Split the file or paste one part at a time.
